name: InstaDomain
description: Domain registration for agents over MCP, settled through OpenSRS/Tucows. Checks availability, suggests names, buys, and auto-provisions a Cloudflare DNS zone, returning a scoped token the agent can manage records with. Pays in USDC on Base over x402 with no account, or by Stripe Checkout or Stripe MPP. Transfer-capable: EPP auth code and unlock are exposed as tools.

agent_endpoints.auth_note: No auth and no account on the x402 path. Two steps: call buy_domain_crypto (POST /buy/crypto) to get a pay_url, then GET that pay_url with an x402-enabled client, which receives the 402 and auto-pays USDC on Base from a funded wallet. Availability checks and suggestions are free and unauthenticated. Small single-developer service on fly.dev — pricing is wholesale plus markup, and it is not an accredited registrar itself.
